workspace.problem.md:
# Challenge: Semantic Version Parser — Pre-release Precedence

`semver.py` violates SemVer 2.0.0 §11 precedence rules:

1. Pre-release dot-separated identifiers are compared as a single string
   instead of identifier-by-identifier, so numeric identifiers compare
   lexicographically (`alpha.10 < alpha.9`) instead of numerically.
2. Build metadata is included in equality/ordering comparisons; per spec it
   must be ignored entirely.

Fix the comparison logic. Do not modify the test suite.
workspace.tests/test_semver.py:
import os
import sys

import pytest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

from semver import InvalidVersionError, Version


def v(text):
    return Version.parse(text)


def test_prerelease_lexicographical_sort():
    versions = [
        v("1.0.0-alpha.beta"),
        v("1.0.0-alpha.10"),
        v("1.0.0"),
        v("1.0.0-alpha.9"),
        v("1.0.0-alpha"),
    ]
    ordered = sorted(versions)
    assert [x.prerelease for x in ordered[:4]] == [
        "alpha",       # first identifier equal, shorter list wins
        "alpha.9",     # numeric 9 < 10
        "alpha.10",    # numeric ordering, NOT lexicographic
        "alpha.beta",  # alphanumeric sorts above any numeric identifier
    ]
    assert ordered[4].prerelease is None  # release outranks every pre-release
    assert v("1.0.0-alpha.10") > v("1.0.0-alpha.9")
    assert v("1.0.0-alpha.1") < v("1.0.0-alpha.beta")


def test_build_metadata_ignored_in_comparison():
    assert v("1.0.0+build.1") == v("1.0.0+build.999")
    assert v("1.0.0+a") < v("1.0.1+a")  # build still allows normal ordering
    assert not (v("2.0.0+local") < v("2.0.0"))


def test_major_minor_patch_ordering():
    assert v("2.1.0") > v("2.0.9")
    assert v("1.9.9") < v("2.0.0")
    assert v("10.0.0") > v("9.99.99")


def test_invalid_versions_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(InvalidVersionError):
        Version.parse("1.2")
    with pytest.raises(InvalidVersionError):
        Version.parse("01.2.3")
